lines: You can stop *time*. Whenever you want.
Your friend Bea knocks her coffee off the table. You press pause, catch it in mid-air, and press play. She never knows.
The whole street is frozen. Cars, birds, raindrops. So you put a traffic cone on every single car.
You give every frozen pigeon a tiny hat. Then you press play... and the whole city *loses its mind*.
But in the silence, one person on the street is *still moving*... and looking straight at you. Who?
Follow and comment... for part two!
